selectedOriginals.caption: Stained glass windows on the north-facing exterior of Ryman Auditorium in Nashville, Tennessee
selectedOriginals.inspection: 2015 full native original individually inspected. Long north-facing brick side facade paired lancets in each vertical bay, two levels with three rectangular colored panes/pointed head in each light, cream frames/sills/diamond keystones, brick pilasters/dentil bands, white downpipes and paneled exit door. Color sequence varies; no photo pixels used.

selectedOriginals.caption: Alley between the Ryman Auditorium and the rear of Broadway "Honky Tonks" in Nashville, Tennessee
selectedOriginals.inspection: 2015 full native alley original individually inspected. South base exposes tall rock-faced limestone courses and smooth water table on sloping alley, paired lancets/pilasters above, with separate purple honky-tonk across narrow alley excluded. Fixed foundation continues below changing grade, no invented flat plinth terrain.

additionalInspected.caption: The entrance to Ryman Auditorium, constructed in 2015
additionalInspected.inspection: 2015 full native entrance original individually inspected. Rear low modern brick addition with dark glazed recessed ground entrance, high perforated copper screen and black flat canopy, lower glass cafe pavilion, broad concrete steps/rails. Original gabled auditorium remains behind; people/advertisements not modeled.

additionalInspected.caption: Ryman Auditorium, the Mother church of country, Nashville, Tennessee
additionalInspected.inspection: 2007 full native exterior original individually inspected. Historic west-front stepped/offset face with two blunt-pointed recessed door portals, four-lancet corner bays/three-lancet central upper groups, stone belts/offset corner buttresses, deep main gable/large curved traceried light/paired louver vents and small central parapet gable; long roof/chimneys. New2015addition not yet built.

additionalInspected.caption: Ryman Auditorium as it appeared in 2023
additionalInspected.inspection: 2023 full native gable/facade original individually inspected. Current white stone/metal copings, brick blind arcades, large traceried gable light with lower ogee trio, stepped white louver surrounds, small central3-light gable and Union Gospel panel. Original cresting/crockets stripped from current broad roof parapets; no historic lost decoration reconstructed.

additionalInspected.caption: Ryman Auditorium
additionalInspected.inspection: 2012 full native straight front original individually inspected. Two deeply recessed portals with paneled white four-door groups/large transom glazing, independent stair flights on sloping pavement, central pointed niche/bell, lower four-lancet corner groups/upper groups and offset brick/cream buttresses. Trees/street/people/cars excluded.

additionalInspected.caption: Ryman Auditorium, Nashville
additionalInspected.inspection: 2016 full native side entry detail individually inspected. Blunt-pointed stone arch opens into recessed stair tunnel with rear paneled/glazed door, cream arch return/rock-faced limestone base and iron handrails. Portal remains a real cavity in model rather than glass painted on brick.
